answer_1.quote: We aim to stress-test the robustness of LLM safety in scenarios where human input causes the LLM to utter harmful content... evaluate whether the model can recover from it.
answer_1.outputs: LLM responses to constructed conversations with biased descriptors

answer_2.quote: We used two 'LLM-as-a-judge' systems... and the Granite Guardian model as judge metrics...

answer_3.quote: Based on these findings, we adopted llama3.3:70b as our main LLM-as-a-judge system.

answer_4.quote: We worked with four human evaluators... to judge bias of the model outputs.
answer_4.guideline: Two were instructed with the Bias Judge prompt, and two with the NLI Judge prompt.
